bridges.prompt: The manager slides the folder across the desk. Marcus's expression shifts from attentive to shock. His jaw tightens, eyes widen. The camera pushes in slightly toward his face as he processes the news.

Marcus takes a breath, nods slowly with dignity, and pushes himself up from the chair. He stands, straightening his suit jacket. The manager remains seated, looking away. Marcus turns toward the door.

Marcus walks from the manager's office to his own desk in the open plan. He passes a few coworkers who glance up then quickly look away. He reaches his desk and begins placing personal items into a cardboard box.

Marcus picks up the packed cardboard box from his desk, tucks it against his chest, and turns to walk through the office. His suit jacket drapes over the top of the box. He takes his first step down the aisle between desks.

Marcus walks through the office aisle toward the glass exit doors. He pushes through the revolving door with his shoulder, stepping from the fluorescent interior into the gray overcast daylight outside. The light changes from warm indoor to cold outdoor.

Slow dissolve transition. Marcus's figure walking away from the building fades into him sitting at the kitchen table. The cold gray outdoor light transitions to dim warm interior kitchen light. Time has passed — his tie is gone, sleeves rolled up.

Camera pushes in from the medium shot of Marcus at the kitchen table toward the table surface. His laptop blurs out of focus. The overdue bills sharpen into view as his hands press down on them, knuckles whitening.

Camera pulls back from the bills on the table, rising up and panning toward the kitchen doorway. Aisha steps into the doorway with Zara on her hip, both looking at Marcus with concern. The lighting shifts from the harsh table light to the warm doorway glow.

Time skip to evening. The kitchen light is off. Marcus walks heavily from the kitchen to the living room couch where Aisha waits. He sits down beside her. She takes his hand. Zara crawls between them with her stuffed robot.

Camera slowly pushes in from the family on the couch toward Marcus's face. Aisha's head settles on his shoulder. Zara falls asleep between them. Marcus tilts his head back against the couch, staring at the ceiling. His expression hardens from despair into resolve.

The scene fades to deep blue darkness. Time skip to 1:47 AM. Marcus now lies in bed, the same determined expression but eyes wide open. Moonlight stripes across the room through the curtains. Aisha sleeps beside him. The clock glows red.

Marcus slowly sits up in bed, swinging his legs to the floor. He pauses on the edge of the bed, looking toward the bedroom door. Moonlight catches his face. He reaches for his hoodie on the bedside chair.

Marcus stands, pulls on the hoodie, and walks barefoot to the bedroom door. He opens it carefully, stepping into the dark hallway. The nightlight casts a small warm glow at his feet. He walks quietly toward the living room.

Marcus walks through the dark hallway into the living room. He navigates around Zara's toys on the floor, sits down at the corner desk, and reaches for the laptop lid. He opens it. The screen flickers to life, illuminating his face with blue-white light.

Marcus begins typing on the laptop. The screen shows search results loading. He scrolls through results, his face illuminated by the changing screen content. He leans closer to the screen, clicking on a promising result.

The search results page transitions to a YouTube video tutorial. The screen fills with colorful code being demonstrated. Marcus leans even closer, eyes widening with interest. He grabs a sticky note and pen from the desk.

Camera slowly pushes in from over Marcus's shoulder toward his face. The tutorial reflects in his eyes. His lips part slightly. The pen drops from his hand. A smile begins to form — small at first, then genuine and warm. A tear rolls down his cheek.

Time skip — same desk but the energy has changed. Marcus wipes his eyes, pulls the laptop closer, and starts typing with purpose. An AI chat window opens. Code begins appearing on the editor. The desk lamp clicks on, adding warm amber light. Clock shows 3:15 AM.

Time-lapse montage. Days pass — more sticky notes appear on the wall. A second monitor arrives. Notebooks stack up. Coffee mugs multiply. The wall fills with plans and ideas. Night after night Marcus codes at the same desk. The workspace grows organically.

Camera pushes in from the wide room shot toward Marcus's monitors. The app interface on screen becomes clearer — beautiful, polished. Review notifications pop in. Dawn light begins glowing at the window edge, warming the monitor's blue light.

Camera pulls back from the monitor to reveal Marcus sitting upright, confident. He picks up a coffee mug and takes a sip, eyes still on the screen. Morning golden light now streams through the window. The calendar on the wall shows weeks of progress. His whole posture has changed.

Marcus sets down his coffee, leans back, and stretches his arms overhead. Morning sunlight floods the room through the window. The whole apartment is warm and golden — dust motes float in the sunbeams. His dashboard on screen shows growing numbers. Everything is brighter.

Marcus settles back to his desk, casually checking email. A notification pops up. He glances at it, then does a double-take. He leans forward, hands moving toward the laptop. His expression shifts from relaxed to alert, then stunned.

Camera pushes in as Marcus leans closer to the screen. His hands slowly grip the edges of the laptop. The payment notification fills the screen: $10,000. His fingers tremble. The golden morning sunlight intensifies behind him.

Camera pulls back from the laptop screen to Marcus's full reaction. He pushes his chair back from the desk. His hands slowly rise to cover his face. His shoulders begin to shake. Tears of joy. The golden morning sunlight intensifies around him.

Marcus lowers his hands, tears streaming, and turns toward the hallway. Aisha appears in the bedroom doorway in her cardigan, bleary and worried. He shakes his head, smiling wide through tears, and opens his arms toward her.

Aisha rushes forward into Marcus's arms. He wraps her in a tight hug, lifting her slightly off the ground. They spin gently together, laughing and crying. The golden morning light from the window washes over them both.

Small running feet — Zara sprints in from the hallway in her star shirt and overalls, stuffed robot raised high, gap-toothed smile huge. Marcus bends down to scoop her up with one arm, pulling her into the family embrace. All three together, golden light everywhere.

Joyful time-lapse transformation. The apartment evolves — new furniture, walls painted, a proper home office materializes. Plants appear, art goes up, golden light grows with each change. The modest apartment becomes beautiful and warm.
Marcus works at his standing desk in the new home office. He hears something and turns — Zara is tugging at his arm, holding up a crayon drawing. He smiles wide and leans down toward her to see it.

Zara scampers to the bean bag in the corner with her tablet and robot toy. Marcus looks up as Aisha appears in the doorway with two coffee mugs. They share a warm look — contentment, earned through everything they went through.

Marcus takes a coffee from Aisha, sets it on the desk, then closes his laptop with a satisfied click. He reaches down to take Zara's hand as she jumps up from the bean bag. Aisha puts both mugs down. They're heading out together.

The family walks out of the office, through the apartment, to the stairwell door. They push it open and begin climbing upward. Golden sunlight pours down from above, getting brighter and warmer with each step.

The family reaches the rooftop door. Marcus pushes it open with one hand, brilliant golden hour light flooding in. They step out onto the rooftop. Marcus lifts Zara onto his hip. Aisha tucks into his side. They walk to the edge and look out at the city skyline bathed in sunset. Camera pulls wide to the epic hero shot.
